name: Euler A2
plain: Rectified-flow ancestral step that draws two noise samples each step, averages, then extrapolates the merged noise away from the deterministic base. The default extrapolation brings the total noise variance back close to one.
math:
ratio=1+(σᵢ₊₁/σᵢ−1)η. σ↓=σᵢ₊₁·ratio. D=(σ↓/σᵢ)x+(1−σ↓/σᵢ)x0. base=(α′/α↓)D. c=√max(0,σᵢ₊₁²−σ↓²α′²/α↓²). p_k=base+n_k·s·c. merged=½(p₁+p₂). x=merged+e(merged−base). Default e=0.425.
So noise = (1+e)/2·(n₁+n₂)·s·c, variance (1+e)²/2·(s·c)² ≈ 1.015(s·c)².
